brief: Lane sp: make speculative decoding fast on the R9700 (gfx1201): baseline MTP on HIP for the 35B and 27B, graph-captured MTP step, device-side acceptance, batched MTP, short-draft policy; lossless only.
hypothesis: Radiance's 3x decode lead on the 27B comes from speculation; intarsiaml's MTP on HIP is eager and loses time to graph breaks and a host round trip.

summary: Captured MTP step and the 27B dense MTP head land (27B 1.39-1.60x lossless on HIP; 35B 1.08-1.27x). Eager HIP MTP was not lossless on the 27B at 4k/16k; verify attention is now per row. Device-side acceptance not built (host gap under 1%). Batched MTP and a short-draft policy NOT done. --mtp-draft-vocab is an opt-in knob (+8-12% 27B English/code, loses on Chinese). The 27B stays far below Radiance's 325 tok/s (TP2 DFlash2 7-token drafter): the limit here is the 3-row MXFP4 GEMV cost and the lm_head sweeps.
lessons: HIP's multi-row split-KV attention is not bitwise the decode step's per row at long context: an MTP equality test on a tiny model at 256 tokens does not see it, only the 27B at 4k/16k does.
Measure the host gap before building device-side acceptance: it was under 1% here.
A reduced-vocab draft head helps English/code and hurts CJK; measure on the traffic.
